title: Semantic Latent Alignment for Flow Matching with Invertible Bi-Lipschitz Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2610.21332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained latent spaces trade compression, reconstruction, and the learnability of the coordinates a downstream generator has to work in, which complicates adapting these spaces to different domains or tasks: continued training is expensive, and without a new alignment objective it often fails to improve downstream generation. We instead leave the encoder and decoder fixed and change only the coordinates between them, using an invertible bi-Lipschitz adapter aligned offline to a semantic teacher and frozen during class-conditional flow matching. Invertibility preserves compatibility with the pretrained autoencoder, while the bi-Lipschitz constraint limits how far alignment can distort its latent geometry. This provides a simple way to improve semantic organization while retaining the compression and reconstruction properties of the original latent space. translated_title: 基于可逆双利普希茨适配器的流匹配语义潜在空间对齐
translated_abstract: 预训练潜在空间在压缩、重建以及下游生成器所工作坐标的可学习性之间存在权衡，这使得将这些空间适配到不同领域或任务变得复杂：继续训练成本高昂，而且在没有新的对齐目标的情况下，往往无法改善下游生成。我们反其道而行之，保持编码器和解码器固定，仅改变它们之间的坐标，使用一个离线对齐到语义教师模型并在类条件流匹配训练期间保持冻结的可逆双利普希茨适配器。可逆性保证了与预训练自编码器的兼容性，而双利普希茨约束则限制了对齐过程对其潜在几何结构的扭曲程度。这提供了一种简单的方法，能够在保留原始潜在空间压缩和重建特性的同时改善其语义组织。在两个医学影像数据集上，受约束的潜在适配改善了特征……
tldr: 提出一种可逆双利普希茨适配器，仅改变预训练自编码器中固定的编码器与解码器之间的坐标，将其潜在空间离线对齐到语义教师模型，从而在保持压缩与重建性能的同时改善流匹配生成的语义组织。
en_tdlr: Proposes an invertible bi-Lipschitz adapter that aligns the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder to a semantic teacher by changing only the coordinates between a fixed encoder and decoder, improving semantic organization for flow matching while preserving the original compression and reconstruction properties.
